definition: something you do to show publicly that you think something is wrong (protest against + something)
exampleSentence: Three people died yesterday in violent protests against the war.
exampleTranslation: Hôm qua có ba người chết trong các cuộc biểu tình bạo lực phản đối chiến tranh.

definition: facts or documents that prove that something is true (proof of + something)
exampleSentence: You need to show proof of identity.
exampleTranslation: Bạn cần xuất trình giấy tờ chứng minh danh tính.

definition: an attempt to persuade someone by using influence or arguments (pressure on + somebody)
exampleSentence: There is a lot of pressure on young people to stay slim.
exampleTranslation: Có rất nhiều áp lực đè lên giới trẻ phải giữ dáng thon.

definition: a sentence you use to ask for information (question about + something)
exampleSentence: They asked me a lot of difficult questions about my job.
exampleTranslation: Họ hỏi tôi rất nhiều câu khó về công việc của tôi.

definition: a subject or problem that needs to be discussed or dealt with (question of + something)
exampleSentence: We discussed the question of confidentiality.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đã bàn về vấn đề bảo mật.

definition: something you feel or do because of something that has happened (reaction to + something)
exampleSentence: What was the government's reaction to the fuel crisis?
exampleTranslation: Phản ứng của chính phủ trước cuộc khủng hoảng nhiên liệu là gì?

definition: the cause of something, or why someone does something (reason for + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: People give different reasons for wanting to change jobs.
exampleTranslation: Mỗi người đưa ra những lý do khác nhau để muốn đổi việc.

definition: a set of instructions for cooking a particular food (recipe for + something)
exampleSentence: Do you have a recipe for tomato soup?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có công thức nấu món súp cà chua không?

definition: information about something that is written down or stored (record of + something)
exampleSentence: I try to keep a record of everything I spend.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cố ghi lại mọi khoản mình chi tiêu.

definition: a decrease in the size, price or amount of something (reduction in + something)
exampleSentence: There has been a slight reduction in the price of oil.
exampleTranslation: Giá dầu đã giảm nhẹ.

definition: a part of what you say or write in which you mention someone or something (reference to + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: There is no direct reference to her own childhood in the novel.
exampleTranslation: Cuốn tiểu thuyết không đề cập trực tiếp đến tuổi thơ của chính cô.

definition: the way two people or groups feel and behave towards each other (relationship between + two people)
exampleSentence: We talked about the special relationship between Britain and the US.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi nói về mối quan hệ đặc biệt giữa Anh và Mỹ.

definition: the way you feel and behave towards another person or group (relationship with + somebody)
exampleSentence: I have a good relationship with my parents.
exampleTranslation: Tôi có mối quan hệ tốt với bố mẹ.

definition: being dependent on someone or something (reliance on + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: The country's reliance on imported oil is a problem.
exampleTranslation: Sự phụ thuộc của đất nước vào dầu nhập khẩu là một vấn đề.

definition: a way of dealing with a problem or making a bad situation better (remedy for + something)
exampleSentence: The program is one remedy for discrimination.
exampleTranslation: Chương trình này là một biện pháp khắc phục nạn phân biệt đối xử.

definition: a written or spoken description of a situation or event (report on + something)
exampleSentence: Colleges must provide a written report on each student's progress.
exampleTranslation: Các trường cao đẳng phải nộp báo cáo bằng văn bản về tiến độ của từng sinh viên.

definition: a polite or formal demand for something (request for + something)
exampleSentence: They have made an urgent request for international aid.
exampleTranslation: Họ đã đưa ra yêu cầu khẩn cấp về viện trợ quốc tế.

definition: serious study of a subject in order to discover new facts (research into + subject)
exampleSentence: There is new research into the causes of cancer.
exampleTranslation: Có nghiên cứu mới về nguyên nhân của bệnh ung thư.

definition: serious study of a subject in order to discover new facts (research on + subject)
exampleSentence: Watson did pioneering research on the long-term effects of dieting.
exampleTranslation: Watson đã có nghiên cứu tiên phong về tác động lâu dài của việc ăn kiêng.

definition: a similarity between two people or things (resemblance to + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Tina bears a striking resemblance to her mother.
exampleTranslation: Tina giống mẹ một cách đáng kinh ngạc.

definition: a feeling of admiring someone or what they do (respect for + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: I have the greatest respect for Jane's work.
exampleTranslation: Tôi hết sức tôn trọng công việc của Jane.

definition: something that is done as a reaction to something that has happened (response to + something)
exampleSentence: The public's response to our appeal for help was generous.
exampleTranslation: Công chúng đã phản hồi rất hào phóng trước lời kêu gọi giúp đỡ của chúng tôi.

definition: a duty to be in charge of someone or something (responsibility for + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: The minister has responsibility for the National Health Service.
exampleTranslation: Bộ trưởng chịu trách nhiệm về Dịch vụ Y tế Quốc gia.

definition: something that happens because of something else (result of + something)
exampleSentence: Accidents are the inevitable result of driving too fast.
exampleTranslation: Tai nạn là kết quả tất yếu của việc lái xe quá nhanh.

definition: the act of coming back to a place or state (return to + place)
exampleSentence: Malcolm decided to delay his return to York.
exampleTranslation: Malcolm quyết định hoãn việc trở về York.

definition: something you get because you have done something good (reward for + something)
exampleSentence: Parents often give their children rewards for passing exams.
exampleTranslation: Bố mẹ thường thưởng cho con khi thi đỗ.

definition: the possibility that something bad or dangerous may happen (risk of + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: Skiers always face the risk of serious injury.
exampleTranslation: Người trượt tuyết luôn đối mặt với nguy cơ chấn thương nặng.

definition: the way in which someone or something is involved in an activity or situation (role in + something)
exampleSentence: Women's role in society has changed a lot.
exampleTranslation: Vai trò của phụ nữ trong xã hội đã thay đổi nhiều.

definition: an official instruction that says how things must be done (rule of + something)
exampleSentence: Everyone must learn the rules of the game.
exampleTranslation: Mọi người phải học các quy tắc của trò chơi.

definition: the act of selling something (sale of + something)
exampleSentence: The sale of marijuana remains illegal.
exampleTranslation: Việc bán cần sa vẫn là bất hợp pháp.

definition: a situation in which there is not enough of something people need (shortage of + something)
exampleSentence: The country has a shortage of skilled labour.
exampleTranslation: Đất nước đang thiếu lao động có tay nghề.

definition: an event or fact that shows something is happening or exists (sign of + something)
exampleSentence: A red morning sky is a sign of an impending storm.
exampleTranslation: Bầu trời đỏ buổi sáng là dấu hiệu của một cơn bão sắp đến.

definition: a way of solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation (solution to + problem)
exampleSentence: There are no simple solutions to the problem of overpopulation.
exampleTranslation: Không có giải pháp đơn giản nào cho vấn đề dân số quá đông.

definition: a way of solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation (solution for + problem/person)
exampleSentence: We are looking for a solution for this problem.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đang tìm giải pháp cho vấn đề này.

definition: a thing, place or activity that you get something from (source of + something)
exampleSentence: Beans are a very good source of protein.
exampleTranslation: Đậu là nguồn protein rất tốt.

definition: a formal talk about a particular subject (speech on + subject)
exampleSentence: The president gave a major speech on relations with China.
exampleTranslation: Tổng thống có bài phát biểu quan trọng về quan hệ với Trung Quốc.

definition: a limited time of living or staying in a place (stay in + place)
exampleSentence: I met her towards the end of my stay in Los Angeles.
exampleTranslation: Tôi gặp cô ấy vào cuối thời gian lưu lại ở Los Angeles.

definition: the achievement of a high position or a goal in a particular area (success in + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: He has already had a lot of success in his career.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy đã gặt hái nhiều thành công trong sự nghiệp.

definition: an idea or plan that someone mentions for others to consider (suggestion for + something)
exampleSentence: Here are some suggestions for further activities.
exampleTranslation: Sau đây là một vài gợi ý cho các hoạt động tiếp theo.

definition: approval, encouragement and help for a person or idea (support for + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: There was widespread support for the plan.
exampleTranslation: Kế hoạch nhận được sự ủng hộ rộng rãi.

definition: a feeling that someone is probably guilty of doing something wrong (suspicion of + something)
exampleSentence: She was arrested on suspicion of murder.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy bị bắt vì bị nghi giết người.

definition: the feeling of being sorry for someone who is in a bad situation (sympathy for + somebody)
exampleSentence: I have a lot of sympathy for her; she brought up the children alone.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rất cảm thông với cô ấy; cô ấy một mình nuôi các con.

definition: a natural ability to do something well (talent for + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: She showed a talent for acting at an early age.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy sớm bộc lộ tài năng diễn xuất từ nhỏ.

definition: a liking for something that you have developed (taste for + something)
translation: sở thích về, khẩu vị với
exampleSentence: In France she developed a taste for fine wines.
exampleTranslation: Ở Pháp, cô ấy hình thành sở thích với rượu vang hảo hạng.

definition: the kind of things that someone likes (taste in + something)
exampleSentence: He asked about my taste in music.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy hỏi về gu âm nhạc của tôi.

definition: an amount of money you must pay to the government on something (tax on + something)
exampleSentence: The government plans a new tax on fuel.
exampleTranslation: Chính phủ dự định đánh một loại thuế mới lên nhiên liệu.

definition: someone or something regarded as a possible danger (threat to + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: The fighting is a major threat to stability in the region.
exampleTranslation: Giao tranh là mối đe dọa lớn đối với sự ổn định của khu vực.

definition: a statement that you will cause harm or trouble, or the possibility of something bad (threat of + something)
exampleSentence: The country lives under the threat of military invasion.
exampleTranslation: Đất nước sống dưới nguy cơ bị xâm lược quân sự.

definition: a journey for pleasure during which you visit several places (tour of + place)
exampleSentence: They took a ten-day tour of China.
exampleTranslation: Họ có một chuyến du lịch Trung Quốc mười ngày.

definition: problems or difficulties with something (trouble with + something)
exampleSentence: We're having a lot of trouble with the new computer system.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đang gặp nhiều rắc rối với hệ thống máy tính mới.
